description: Sample external rules for DCS mission validation - now using separate files for modularity
note: This sample file is now deprecated in favor of using the 'externalRules' field approach. The validator will merge categories from all loaded JSON rule files automatically.
$comment:
Each category below has been extracted into its own JSON file:
- awacs.json
- carriers.json  
- farp-rules.json
- red-air-forces.json
- blue-aircraft-checks.json
- base-ground-checks.json
- naming-conventions.json
- weather-settings.json
- carrier-rules.json (duplicate of carriers.json)
- tankers.json
- cleanup-rules.json

To use: Create a config file with 'externalRules' field pointing to these files.
Example:
{
  "categories": [],
  "externalRules": [
    "./rules/awacs.json",
    "./rules/farp-rules.json", 
    "./rules/naming-conventions.json"
  ]
}

categories.name: Naming Conventions
categories.description: Rules about unit names and patterns

categories.name: BLUE Aircraft Configuration
categories.description: BLUE coalition unit configurations for air superiority checks

$comment:
These rules are loaded automatically when you specify 'externalRules' field in your config.
See docs/EXTENDING-MISSIONS-WITH-JSON-RULES.md for usage examples.
